title: finding(types): four objectui#8499 arms of `AnyComponentSchema` have no named export on `./zod` — the objectui#7917 defect recurred one day after its repair
body:
Filed from the objectui#8784 implementation run (the pin that fails when an `AnyComponentSchema` arm has no named zod export), by the `os-dev` seat on branch `claude/issue-8784-arm-named-export-pin`, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`. Filed unassigned and ungraded — `domain:*`, type and priority are the triage seat's. Not ridden onto that PR: adding an exported symbol is a `Clause-2` act and objectui#8784's dispatch says stop and report first.

## The reading

Fresh census on `7f27bc54343e6193f11ec3f58927fb9afb1bc635`, derived (not hard-coded): flatten `AnyComponentSchema` recursively through unions and `z.lazy`, then match each leaf arm to a named export of `./zod` **by identity**.

**111 arms / 154 `type` literals / 106 named / 5 unnamed.**

Four of the five are unnamed by accident:

| arm | `type` literals | landed |
|---|---|---|
| `layout.zod.ts#SemanticElementSchema` | 7 (`aside`, `main`, `header`, `nav`, `footer`, `section`, `article`) | `507b61bf7` |
| `layout.zod.ts#HtmlElementSchema` | 37 (`h1` … `q`) | `507b61bf7` |
| `form.zod.ts#InputShorthandSchema` | 2 (`email`, `password`) | `507b61bf7` |
| `form.zod.ts#UiCalendarSchema` | 1 (`ui:calendar`) | `507b61bf7` |

The fifth, `complex.zod.ts#RetiredKanbanNodeSchema` (`kanban`), is DECLARED internal in as many words on the barrel itself — "it is deliberately NOT exported — nothing outside this package parses against a refusal arm" (objectui#8802, maintainer ruling 2026-09-09). That one is correct as it stands and is ledgered as such by the objectui#8784 pin.

## Why this is the objectui#7917 defect again, not a new one

`507b61bf7` is PR #8763, `fix(types): arm AnyComponentSchema for seven registered node-slot renderers (objectui#8499)`, merged 2026-09-09T07:53:59Z. Its own commit message states the move: "Four arms, 47 literals, 107 to 154". Its file list touches `packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts` and `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` and **does not touch `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`** — the same shape as objectui#7917's `ObjectTreeSchema`, which PR #1892 added to a module and never to the barrel.

`./zod` is this package's ONLY zod subpath (`packages/types/package.json` maps it to `dist/zod/index.zod.js`), and the barrel carries no star re-export — every name on it is written out by hand. So these four schemas are maintained, are applied by the union, and cannot be named by any consumer: declared-and-unreachable, which is exactly the state objectui#7917 measured and PR #8777 repaired for the two arms it found.

They are not marginal or half-declared. All four were registered as first-class mirror pairs in the same PR — `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` gained a `ZOD_MIRRORS` row and a TypeScript counterpart for each, and `EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` moved 158 to 162. The objectui#7917 repair used exactly that fact ("the parity census registers both as first-class mirrors with a TS counterpart rather than exempting them") as its evidence that the omission was accidental.

None of the four carries any of this directory's seven "Deliberately NOT exported" / "`@internal` … is not re-exported" markers.

## Timing — why objectui#8784 reads 107/107/0 and this reads 111/154/5

objectui#8784 was filed 2026-09-09T07:05:02Z. `507b61bf7` merged 48 minutes later. The card's census was correct when it was taken and went stale within the hour, which is itself the strongest available argument for the pin objectui#8784 asks for: the invariant broke again, in the same way, one day after a review repaired it, and nothing said a word.

## What is being asked

A ruling per arm: re-export it from `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`, or mark it deliberately internal with a reason the way `RetiredKanbanNodeSchema` is marked.

Recommendation: export all four. Each is a registered, live renderer with catalog fixtures (that is why objectui#8499 armed them); each has a TypeScript counterpart already; and the alternative reading — that a `type` an author is taught to write in `content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx` should be un-nameable — matches nothing else on this face.

Cost if exported: four new names on a published surface, hence `Clause-2`. Cost if not: an author validating a single `h1` node has no schema to validate it against, and objectui#8784's pin carries four ledger rows saying the answer is owed.

Until the ruling lands, the objectui#8784 pin ledgers all four against this card, so nothing here is silent and no NEW omission can hide behind them.

Refs: objectui#7917 (the same defect, two other arms) · PR #8777 (its repair) · objectui#8499 (the card that armed these four) · PR #8763 (`507b61bf7`, the commit that armed them without the barrel) · objectui#8784 (the pin) · objectui#8802 (the `RetiredKanbanNodeSchema` ruling)

Dedup: the 300 most recently updated issues and pull requests were listed over the repository-scoped REST issues endpoint and grepped locally for `HtmlElementSchema`, `SemanticElementSchema`, `UiCalendarSchema`, `InputShorthandSchema`, `barrel`, `named export`, `index.zod` and `8499` — a live reader, 25 substantive hits including objectui#8784 itself, none claiming this. Bounded honestly: the search endpoint is not reachable from this session, so this is a recency-window read, not a full-corpus one; the defect is 1.5 days old, so a card about it would fall inside that window. Nearest neighbour is objectui#8775, which is about whether the same seven sectioning tags belong in the curated layout vocabulary — a different question about the same arms.
